metadata.description: Autonomous issue-to-PR agent runs, distributed as a single installable plugin.

plugins.name: bottega
plugins.description: /bottega:maestro is the whole pipeline: the orchestrator settles the unknowns with the user, owns the design, builds with worker agents under per-slice cross-model review, has the integrated diff reviewed and repaired by a fresh closeout seat with a two-engine panel when the diff warrants the spend, drives QA on every surface the work touched, and delivers a PR that merges itself on green or waits held, as the user answered at launch. The user takes part in two places, discovery and that launch answer. autoreview, improve, panel, setup, and bro are available on their own.
